theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate is the only validated leg and it currently deems AI Infrastructure eligible with a healthy durability bar (0.73) and broad participation (breadth 0.875). This is a trend-discipline lean, not a momentum-return forecast: the theme is where leadership is concentrating, and the gate argues for staying with it while it holds trend rather than rotating away on a crowding signal.
evidence: eligible=true with durability_bar 0.73 (well above the fragile 0.3-0.4 zone)
breadth 0.875 suggests the uptrend is technically broad, not one-stock driven
crowded=false (crowding_z 0.81), so no size-down caution triggered
hurst_tag 'mixed' but the absolute-trend gate is the validated risk leg, and it is green
theses.dissent: Semiconductor proxy SMH carries enormous AI-concentration risk; a single AI-capex guidance disappointment from a hyperscaler could hit the whole basket regardless of breadth, and the rank-IC being ~0 means there is no historical edge from being long the leader for return.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 5 consecutive sessions before the 20-day check-by

theses.subject: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
theses.thesis: Eligible and durable (durability_bar 0.8) with very strong breadth (0.938), but crowded=true (crowding_z 1.01). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade, so the lean stays overweight but the crowding flag means treat any exposure as capped rather than adding. This is the challenger in rotation, only 0.555 behind the leader.
evidence: eligible=true, durability_bar 0.8, the highest durability among the top eligible themes
breadth 0.938 — nearly all constituents participating in trend
crowded=true at crowding_z 1.01 — a caution, not a sell signal
theses.dissent: WFE is late-cycle semis with a strong memory/HBM spillover; crowding_z above 1.0 is exactly the zone where attention spikes have historically marked local tops, and the detector itself warns not to treat attention as a buy.

falsifier.text: SMH and the WFE constituents both underperform the S&P 500 by 5% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Eligible and technically pristine (durability_bar 0.81, breadth 1.0, hurst_tag trend) but extremely crowded at crowding_z 1.91, the highest crowding reading among eligible themes. The detector's one documented failure mode is fading a leader on crowding; here cybersecurity is not the leader, and extreme crowding plus a coincident-only edge argues for caution on holding it, but framed as underweight rather than avoid because the trend gate is green.
evidence: crowding_z 1.91 — far above the 1.0 caution threshold
durability_bar 0.81 and breadth 1.0 suggest the trend itself is healthy (why this is underweight, not avoid)
rank 4 with positive score 1.252, so still a top-5 theme
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity is the cleanest trend in the whole table (breadth 1.0, durability 0.81) and crowding in secular-growth software can persist for quarters; underweighting a pristine trend purely on a coincident crowding flag risks missing continued leadership.

falsifier.text: CIBR outperforms SPY by 10% over the next 60 trading days
